cards.definition: How big or small a piece of clothing is: small, medium, large.
cards.example:
- Do you have this in a small size?
Vocês têm isto em tamanho pequeno?
cards.note: Pergunta pronta: what size? Resposta: small, medium, large — S, M, L na etiqueta.

cards.definition: To be the right size for your body.
cards.example:
- This does not fit. It is too small.
Não serve. Está pequeno demais.
cards.note: Fit é caber no corpo. Não confunda com like: pode servir e você não gostar.

cards.definition: To put clothes on in the shop, before you buy them.
cards.example:
- Can I try on this shirt?
Posso experimentar esta camisa?
cards.note: Separável: com pronome ele abre — try it on, nunca “try on it”. O provador é o fitting room.

cards.definition: The money the shop gives back to you.
cards.example:
- Here is your change: two dollars.
Aqui está o seu troco: dois dólares.
cards.note: Também é “trocar” e “mudar”. Na loja, com dinheiro na mão, é sempre o troco.

cards.definition: The small paper you keep, to return something later.
cards.example:
- Keep the receipt. You can return it.
Guarde a nota. Você pode devolver.
cards.note: O p é mudo: fala-se “ri-SÍT”. Sem ele não existe troca nem devolução.

cards.definition: Costing a lot of money. The opposite of cheap.
cards.example:
- This bag is very expensive.
Esta bolsa é muito cara.
cards.note: O contrário é cheap. Para dizer “caro demais”: too expensive.

cards.definition: What you say when you want to test a piece of clothing.
cards.example:
- I like this one. Can I try it on?
Eu gostei desta. Posso experimentar?
cards.note: O pronome vai NO MEIO. Try it on, nunca “try on it” — é o erro número um aqui.

cards.definition: How you ask for another colour or another size.
cards.example:
- Do you have this in blue?
Vocês têm isto em azul?
cards.note: Serve para cor e tamanho: in blue, in a large, in another colour.

cards.definition: Clothes for a party or a play. It is NOT a habit.
cards.example:
- The shop sells Halloween costumes.
A loja vende fantasias de Halloween.
cards.note: “Costume” de hábito é habit! Costume é roupa de fantasia, de teatro.

cards.definition: The part of a shirt around your neck. It is NOT a necklace.
cards.example:
- The shirt has a white collar.
A camisa tem gola branca.
cards.note: “Colar” de pescoço é necklace! Collar é a gola da camisa.

questions.prompt: Do you have this in a small _____ ?
questions.explanation: Small, medium, large — S, M, L on the label.

questions.prompt: Do you have this _____ a small size?
questions.explanation: IN a size, IN a colour.
Fit takes the person straight: fit me, not fit in me.
Separable: with a pronoun it splits. Never “try on it”.
With money in your hand, change is what comes back.

questions.prompt: Keep the _____ . You can return it.
It is _____ expensive. I cannot pay.
questions.explanation: TOO expensive = more than you will pay. VERY expensive is only “quite dear”.
Works for colour and for size.
“Costume” de hábito is a custom. A costume is fancy dress.
A necklace goes around your neck; a collar is part of the shirt.
